evolves.rules: Max HP 20. Route battles hurt 1 less.

cards.title: Bidoof
cards.rules: Nobody chooses Bidoof. Max HP 16. Every 20 is rerolled. The bag holds 2.

evolves.title: Bibarel
evolves.rules: Max HP 15. −1 to boss d20s. Every 20 is rerolled. The bag holds 2.

cards.title: Magikarp
cards.rules: Magikarp chose you. It used Splash. Nothing happened. Max HP 15. −1 to every battle d20.

evolves.title: Gyarados
evolves.rules: Max HP 20. +1 to every battle d20.

cards.title: Togepi
cards.rules: Togepi chose you. It does nothing, but it's very happy to be here.

evolves.title: Togetic
evolves.rules: Max HP 17.

cards.title: Sunkern
cards.rules: Sunkern chose you. It is a seed with a face. Max HP 20.

evolves.title: Sunflora
evolves.rules: Max HP 21.

cards.title: Drowzee
cards.rules: Drowzee chose you, yawning. Now you're yawning. Every heal heals 2 more. Bosses take 1 more hit.

evolves.title: Hypno
evolves.rules: Max HP 18. Every heal heals 2 more.

cards.title: Zubat
cards.rules: Zubat chose you. It flew into a wall doing it. Max HP 20. Natural 1 on a 1 or 2.

evolves.title: Golbat
evolves.rules: Max HP 20. +1 to every battle d20.

cards.title: Pidgey
cards.rules: Wild Pidgey appeared! It throws Sand Attack right at your eyes.

cards.title: Rattata
cards.rules: Wild Rattata is chewing your shoelaces like it pays rent.

strike.even: Evicted. Whoever has the worst shoes drinks 2.
strike.disadvantage: It bites your ankle. Drink 4 on one foot.

cards.title: Zigzagoon
cards.rules: Wild Zigzagoon is zigzagging toward you. Zigzag your head with it and roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You zag straight into a wall. Drink 6 and sit on the floor.
Dizzy. Drink {total}.
Pickup! Steal a sip from any drink at the table.
Natural 20! Pickup! Steal two sips from any drink at the table.

cards.title: Bidoof
cards.rules: Wild Bidoof appeared, with the dead eyes of a man on his fourth divorce. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It stares into your soul. Drink 2 without blinking.
Bidoof wanders off to find wife five. Give 2.

dice.doubles: A pair! Bidoof proposes. Your left neighbor officiates and drinks 3.

cards.title: Wooloo
cards.rules: Wild Wooloo rolls at you like a drunk sheep down a hill.

strike.even: You hop it like a hurdle. Give 2.
strike.advantage: You shear it and keep the sweater. Give 3.

cards.title: Lechonk
cards.rules: Wild Lechonk is snorting your snacks. Everyone oinks at it.

strike.even: Bacon later. The quietest oinker drinks 2.
strike.disadvantage: It eats the whole bag. Drink 4, oink.

cards.title: Youngster Joey
cards.rules: Joey says his Rattata is in the top percentage of Rattata. Prove him wrong. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It was. Drink 6 and apologize to Joey.
It was. Drink 3 and apologize to Joey.
Top percentage, bottom of the bracket. The player on your right plays Joey, sobbing, or drinks 2.
Natural 20! Top percentage, bottom of the bracket. The player on your right plays Joey, sobbing, or drinks 4.

cards.title: Bug Catcher
cards.rules: A kid with a bug net bets you can't name five bug Pokémon in 10 seconds. Lose: drink 2.

cards.title: One-Way Ledge
cards.rules: You hop the ledge and can never go back up. Your ankle has opinions. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Rolled it. Drink 4 standing on your good foot.
Rolled it. Drink 2 standing on your good foot.
Stuck the landing. Give 1 and take a bow.
Natural 20! Stuck the landing. Give 2 and take a bow.

cards.title: Caterpie
cards.rules: A Caterpie is just sitting there being a little guy. Will the table catch it?

cards.title: Mystery Egg
cards.rules: A stranger in a trench coat hands you an egg. It's warm. Too warm.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It hatches into a Togepi and pisses on you. Drink 6.
It hatches into a Togepi and pisses on you. Drink 3.
It hatches into something useful. Name it: the player on your left gives 2 and does its cry.
Natural 20! It hatches into something useful. Name it: the player on your left gives 4 and does its cry.

cards.title: Finders Keepers
cards.rules: Someone dropped something in the grass. It's yours now. Everyone drinks 1 to celebrate.

cards.title: Viridian Center
cards.rules: Nurse Joy takes your team and gives it back in 5 seconds. Everyone toasts Nurse Joy.

cards.title: Viridian Mart
cards.rules: The clerk makes you run Oak's parcel back to Pallet Town first. Fine. Now he'll sell.

cards.title: Two Paths
cards.rules: A short path through tall grass, or a long one where a trainer wants a fight.

cards.title: Oddish
cards.rules: Wild Oddish is a radish with legs, walking in circles.

strike.advantage: You pull it up like a carrot. Give 2.
strike.disadvantage: Sleep Powder. Drink 4 with your eyes closed.

cards.title: Diglett
cards.rules: A Diglett pops up between your feet. Stomp once.

strike.disadvantage: It trips you from below. Drink 4.

cards.title: Pichu
cards.rules: Wild Pichu sparks. It shocks itself more than you.

strike.even: It faints from its own spark. Give 2.

cards.title: Pokédex Entry
cards.rules: Describe the player on your left like a Pokédex entry. If the table finds it boring, you drink 2.

cards.title: Starter Pose
cards.rules: Everyone strikes their starter's pose and holds it. The first to move drinks 2.

cards.title: Trade Evolution
cards.rules: Swap drinks with the player across from you, then both drink 1. Trade evolution!

cards.title: Tall Grass Names
cards.rules: Go around naming Pokémon found in tall grass. Whoever repeats one or stalls drinks 2.

cards.title: Oak's Lecture
cards.rules: Professor Oak says there's a time and place for everything. Everyone sits up straight and drinks 1.

elite.title: Ace Trainer Kenny
elite.rules: Kenny has trained since he was four, and his Rattata is in its prime. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: He explains EV training at length. Drink 3.
Rattata crits. Drink 3 and say "good game, Kenny."
Kenny cries. Everyone says "aww"; the last to say it drinks 3.
Kenny calls his mom. The player on your right plays her and scolds him, or drinks 3.
Kenny quits forever. Give 4.
Kenny gives you his hat. Give 4.

elite.title: Lass Tiffany
elite.rules: Lass Tiffany says you looked at her. Battle to prove you didn't. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You did. Drink 6, and look only at the floor until your next turn.
You did. Drink 3, and look only at the floor until your next turn.
She backs off out of respect. Give 3.
Natural 20! She backs off out of respect. Give 6.

rule.name: Clear Skies
rule.rule: When a card names a flying Pokémon, everyone points up. Last to point drinks 1.

cards.title: Brock
cards.rules: Brock is busy hitting on Nurse Joy. Hit on someone here for him, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Onix flattens you. Drink 10.
Onix flattens you. Drink 5.
You chip through. Give 3.
Natural 20! Critical hit. Give 6.

cards.title: Falkner
cards.rules: Drink 3 standing on one foot. Touch down before you finish and you lose: drink 3 more.

cards.title: Roxanne
cards.rules: Name 8 Pokémon types in 10 seconds. Miss any and you lose: drink 2 per miss.

cards.title: Roark
cards.rules: Roark shines his miner's headlamp right in your eyes. Squint at him, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Black lung. Finish your drink.
Cave-in. Drink 4 with your eyes shut.
You strike coal. Shine your phone light on a player; they drink 3.
Natural 20! You strike coal. Shine your phone light on a player; they drink 6.

cards.title: Cilan, Chili & Cress
cards.rules: Waiters' test: recite everyone's drink in seat order. Each miss: drink 2. Two misses lose.

cards.title: Viola
cards.rules: Viola's photo shoot: hold a pose for 30 seconds while the table heckles. Laugh: drink 4.

cards.title: Ilima
cards.rules: Ilima is pretty and knows it. Compliment yourself for 10 seconds straight, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Totem Gumshoos. Drink 8 and compliment your left neighbor.
Totem Gumshoos. Drink 4 and compliment your left neighbor.
Trial cleared. Pick a player: they compliment themselves for 10 seconds or drink 3.
Natural 20! Prettier than Ilima. Give 6.

cards.title: Milo
cards.rules: Milo herds Wooloo. Baa like a sheep for 20 seconds. Nobody laughs: drink 4.

cards.title: Katy
cards.rules: Katy's bugs got in the cake batter. Take a big bite of nothing, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You found a leg. Finish your drink.
Sticky Web. Drink 4 with your elbows stuck to the table.
Sugar crash for Katy. Give 3.
Natural 20! Sugar crash for Katy. Give 6.

rule.name: Clear Skies
rule.rule: When a card names a flying Pokémon, everyone points up. Last to point drinks 1.

cards.title: Spearow
cards.rules: Wild Spearow is angrier than any bird has a right to be. Roll d6 for its move.

outcomes.instruction: Fury Attack: four pecks. Drink 4.
Peck. Rude. Give 1.
Leer. You leer back harder. Give 2.
Growl. Everyone growls at it; the quietest drinks 2.
It flies off to bother Ash. Give 2.
Drill Peck misses and hits your right neighbor. They drink 3.

cards.title: Ekans
cards.rules: Wild Ekans wraps around your leg and hisses something filthy.

strike.even: It squeezes. Drink 2 and hiss back.
strike.advantage: You tie it in a bow. Give 3.

cards.title: Wurmple
cards.rules: Wild Wurmple appeared! Nobody knows what it becomes. Not even Wurmple. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Existential dread. Drink 2 and name your biggest regret.
It becomes a footnote. Everyone says what they'd evolve into; the dullest answer drinks 2.

dice.doubles: A pair! It evolves mid-fight into something nobody predicted. Give {total}.

cards.title: Starly
cards.rules: A whole flock of Starly. Everyone flaps their arms.

strike.even: Bird chaos. The slowest flapper drinks 2.
strike.disadvantage: They steal your snack and your dignity. Drink 4.

cards.title: Lillipup
cards.rules: Wild Lillipup wants belly rubs. Rub the nearest belly at the table.

strike.even: Good boy. The rubbed player gives 2.
strike.disadvantage: It bites the hand that feeds. Drink 4.

cards.title: Yungoos
cards.rules: Wild Yungoos is a sausage with teeth and a bad attitude. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It bites your sausage. Drink 6 with your legs crossed.
It bites your sausage. Drink 3 with your legs crossed.
Sausage served. Whoever has the longest name drinks 2.
Natural 20! Sausage served. Whoever has the longest name drinks 4.

cards.title: Hiker Dave
cards.rules: Hiker Dave hasn't showered since Mt. Moon. Hug your left neighbor.

strike.even: He shares his trail mix. Drink 2.
strike.advantage: He's too tired to fight. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: His Geodude rolls you flat. Drink 4.

cards.title: Picnicker Gina
cards.rules: Picnicker Gina dares you to eat something off the floor. Do it or drink 3.

cards.title: Zubat Cave
cards.rules: Mt. Moon. No Repel. Zubat every step. Roll d6 for how many.

outcomes.instruction: Six Zubat. Drink 3 and bite a neck.
Five Zubat. Drink 2, flapping.
Two Zubat. Give 1.
One Zubat. Give 1.
A Clefairy instead. Give 2.
No Zubat at all. A miracle. Give 3.

cards.title: Clefairy
cards.rules: A Clefairy is dancing under the moon. It's beautiful. Wipe a tear and decide.

cards.title: Rare Candy
cards.rules: A Rare Candy on the ground, a little linty. Your starter is staring at it.

cards.title: Pewter Center
cards.rules: The Center reeks of antiseptic and Brock's cologne. Everyone breathes in and drinks 1.

cards.title: Pewter Mart
cards.rules: The Pewter Mart sells mostly rocks. The clerk is also mostly rock.

cards.title: Mt. Moon Fork
cards.rules: Through the cave, or around it, past trainers who haven't seen daylight in weeks.

cards.title: Shiny Rock
cards.rules: You find a shiny rock and decide it's a weapon now. Give 1.

cards.title: Seedot
cards.rules: Wild Seedot is an acorn, and it is judging you.

strike.advantage: You drop it in a planter. Give 2.
strike.disadvantage: Bullet Seed, right in the shin. Drink 4.

cards.title: Geodude
cards.rules: The rock you sat on was a Geodude. Stand up.

strike.even: Defense Curl, then a headbutt. Drink 2.
strike.advantage: You skip it across the pond. Give 3.

cards.title: Snubbull
cards.rules: Wild Snubbull growls through its underbite. Growl back.

strike.advantage: It rolls over for you. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: It bites and won't let go. Drink 4.

cards.title: Whose Cry?
cards.rules: The drawer makes a Pokémon's cry. First to name it gives 2. Nobody does: the drawer drinks 2.

cards.title: Team Rocket Motto
cards.rules: Everyone recites the Team Rocket motto, badly. The worst performance, by vote, drinks 2.

cards.title: Cave Echo
cards.rules: Pass "Zubat" around the table, each player louder. The first to break the pattern drinks 2.

cards.title: Fossil Dig
cards.rules: Go around naming dinosaurs, fossils or rocks. The first to blank drinks 2.

cards.title: Berry Tree
cards.rules: Everyone names a berry that doesn't exist. The silliest name, by vote, gives 2.

cards.title: Link Cable
cards.rules: A stranger offers to trade your starter over a link cable. It's not a scam. Probably.

elite.title: Super Nerd Miguel
elite.rules: Miguel will fight you for the Helix Fossil. He's been here for weeks. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He wins and explains why. Drink 6 and say "Praise Helix."
He wins and explains why. Drink 3 and say "Praise Helix."
You take the fossil. Everyone yells "Praise Helix!"; the last one drinks 3.
Natural 20! You take the fossil. Everyone yells "Praise Helix!"; the last one drinks 6.

elite.title: Twins Amy & May
elite.rules: Double battle, and both twins talk at once. Pick a partner, then roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Two on two, and you lost. You and your partner drink 3.
Both twins cry in stereo. You and your partner give 2 each.

dice.doubles: A pair! Perfect sync. You and your partner give {total} between you.

rule.name: Tall Grass
rule.rule: When a wild Pokémon appears, the drawer does its cry. The table boos a bad one: drink 1.

cards.title: Misty
cards.rules: Misty's Cascade. Chug for 10 seconds without stopping. Stop early: drink 4 more.

cards.title: Bugsy
cards.rules: Bugsy's bugs got in your pants. Roll 3d6 and check your shorts.

outcomes.instruction: Bitten. Drink 5.
Bitten. Drink 5.
Bitten. Drink 4.
Bitten. Drink 4.
Bitten. Drink 3.
Bitten. Drink 3.
Bitten. Drink 2.
Bitten. Drink 2.
You squash them. Give 4.

cards.title: Brawly
cards.rules: Brawly wants 10 push-ups in 20 seconds. Fall short: drink 6.

cards.title: Gardenia
cards.rules: Gardenia fears ghosts. Tell her a ghost story in 20 seconds. Table votes not scary: drink 4.

cards.title: Lenora
cards.rules: Lenora runs a museum and you're the exhibit. Hold a statue pose while you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Retaliate. Drink 8 without breaking the pose.
Retaliate. Drink 4 without breaking the pose.
You beat the curator. Give 4.
Natural 20! Masterpiece. Give 8.

cards.title: Grant
cards.rules: Grant makes you climb. Crawl under the table and out the other side, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You fall off the wall. Drink 8 from under the table.
You fall off the wall. Drink 4 from under the table.
You top out. Give 4.
Natural 20! Free solo. Give 8.

cards.title: Hala
cards.rules: Hala's sumo: palm-push your right neighbor. Move a foot first: drink 5.

cards.title: Nessa
cards.rules: Nessa is a model and you are not. Pout for the camera, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Gigantamax Drednaw. Finish your drink.
Drowned in looks. Drink 4 and keep pouting.
You make the cover. Pick a player: they strike a pose or drink 3.
Natural 20! You make the cover. Pick a player: they strike a pose or drink 6.

cards.title: Brassius
cards.rules: Brassius demands art. Pose as a Pokémon statue. Nobody names it: drink 4.

rule.name: Tall Grass
rule.rule: When a wild Pokémon appears, the drawer does its cry. The table boos a bad one: drink 1.

cards.title: Psyduck
cards.rules: Wild Psyduck clutches its head, staring at nothing. Clutch yours too.

cards.title: Machop
cards.rules: Wild Machop wants to arm-wrestle. Flex for the table, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Karate Chop to the junk. Drink 6 and say "thank you, sensei."
Karate Chop to the junk. Drink 3 and say "thank you, sensei."
You flex harder. Pick a player to arm-wrestle you: the loser drinks 2.
Natural 20! You flex harder. Pick a player to arm-wrestle you: the loser drinks 4.

cards.title: Shinx
cards.rules: Wild Shinx sparks when it sees you. Every hair on your body stands up.

cards.title: Roggenrola
cards.rules: Wild Roggenrola is a rock with an ear. It heard what you said about it.

strike.even: It sulks. Say something nice, then drink 2.
strike.advantage: You skip it across a lake. Give 3.

cards.title: Pikipek
cards.rules: Wild Pikipek drills a tree. Then your skull. Knock on the table, then roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Woodpecked. Drink 3 and rub your head.
It finds a better tree. Everyone knocks on the table; the last to stop drinks 2.

dice.doubles: A pair! It drums a beat. Everyone drums the table; the last to stop drinks 3.

cards.title: Nickit
cards.rules: Wild Nickit steals the drink nearest you. Roll d20 to get it back.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It's gone. Finish whatever you have, then a fresh one.
It's gone. Finish whatever you have.
Recovered, with a tip. Steal a sip from any drink at the table.
Natural 20! Recovered, with a tip. Steal two sips from any drink at the table.

cards.title: Swimmer Brad
cards.rules: Swimmer Brad is in a Speedo on dry land and won't explain. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You looked. Drink 6 and describe what you saw.
You looked. Drink 3 and describe what you saw.
He goes back to the sea. Everyone in shorts drinks 2.
Natural 20! He goes back to the sea. Everyone in shorts drinks 4.

cards.title: Juggler Rico
cards.rules: Juggler Rico juggles three Voltorb. Juggle any two things for 5 seconds or drink 3.

cards.title: Prepare for Trouble
cards.rules: Jessie and James net you from their balloon. Recite their motto, then roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Netted. Drink 3.
Meowth scratches. Drink 2.
Wobbuffet! Give 1.
They argue about the motto. Give 2.
They blast off again. Give 2.
They blast off again! Everyone points up; the last to point drinks 3.

jinx.name: That's Right!
jinx.rule: The jinxed player ends every sentence with "That's right!" Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Abra
cards.rules: An Abra is asleep. It will teleport the second you move. Throw now?

cards.title: What? It's Evolving!
cards.rules: Your starter glows in the middle of the road. Everyone hums the evolution music.

cards.title: Cerulean Center
cards.rules: Nurse Joy again. Same face, new town. Everyone swears it's the same one and drinks 1.

cards.title: Cerulean Mart
cards.rules: The bike shop wants a million for a bike. The Mart next door is reasonable.

cards.title: Nugget Bridge
cards.rules: Cross the bridge, trainers and all, or swim under it.

cards.title: Hidden Item
cards.rules: The Itemfinder beeps at a bush. Somebody kick it. The drawer gives 1.

cards.title: Voltorb
cards.rules: A Poké Ball on the path. Pick it up? It's a Voltorb. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Self-Destruct, in your hand. Drink 6.
Self-Destruct, in your hand. Drink 3.
You roll it to your left neighbor, who drinks 2 and screams.
Natural 20! You roll it to your left neighbor, who drinks 4 and screams.

cards.title: Sandshrew
cards.rules: Wild Sandshrew curls into a ball and rolls at your drink.

strike.advantage: You catch it like a bowling pin. Give 3.

cards.title: Bellsprout
cards.rules: Wild Bellsprout sways like it's had six. Sway with it.

strike.advantage: It faints into your lap. Give 3.

cards.title: Type Quiz
cards.rules: The drawer names a type. The next player names one that beats it. Wrong drinks 2, right gives 1.

cards.title: Badge Brag
cards.rules: Brag about the last thing you won. Everyone else votes: the weakest brag drinks 2.

cards.title: Daycare Couple
cards.rules: The drawer picks two players to be a Daycare couple. Both drink 1 and name their egg.

cards.title: Contest Pose
cards.rules: Everyone strikes a Contest pose for 5 seconds. The table picks the winner, who gives 3.

cards.title: Name Rater
cards.rules: The Name Rater loves the name of the player on your right. Everyone toasts them and drinks 1.

elite.title: The Recruiter
elite.rules: Nugget Bridge's last man hands you a nugget and a Team Rocket pitch. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You signed something. Drink 8 and do the Rocket pose.
You signed something. Drink 4 and do the Rocket pose.
You keep the nugget and don't join. Give 3.
Natural 20! You keep the nugget and don't join. Give 6.

elite.title: Cooltrainer Ava
elite.rules: Cooltrainer Ava has six fully evolved Pokémon on Route 3. Rude. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Her Gyarados sweeps. Drink 4.
Her Alakazam reads your mind. Drink 3 and read your last text aloud.
You sweep her back. Everyone sweeps an arm; the slowest drinks 3.
She rage-quits. Give 3.
She asks for your number. Give 4.
She retires on the spot. Give 4.

rule.name: Rain
rule.rule: Lost a battle? Do a short rain dance. Refuse: drink 1.

cards.title: Lt. Surge
cards.rules: Lt. Surge wants to see your service record. Salute him and roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Shocked. Drink 4.
You ground him. Give 4.

dice.doubles: A pair! Paralyzed. Finish your drink.

cards.title: Whitney
cards.rules: Whitney's Miltank used Rollout. It gets worse every hit. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Rollout hits once. Drink 1.
Rollout hits twice. Drink 3.
Three hits. Drink 6.
Four hits. Drink 10.
Whitney bursts into tears. Give 5.

cards.title: Wattson
cards.rules: Wahahaha! Wattson licks a battery and dares you to do the same. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Shocked. Drink {total}.
You lick it first. Give 5.

dice.doubles: A pair! Overcharge. Everyone else drinks {total}.

cards.title: Maylene
cards.rules: Maylene fights barefoot. Shoes off, thumb-war your left neighbor. Lose: drink 5.

cards.title: Burgh
cards.rules: Burgh's art test: finger-draw a bug on your neighbor's back. They can't name it: drink 4.

cards.title: Korrina
cards.rules: Korrina's on skates. Spin 5 times, then walk a straight line. Wobble: drink 5.

cards.title: Lana
cards.rules: Lana lies. Tell two truths and a lie. The table spots the lie: drink 5.

cards.title: Kabu
cards.rules: Kabu jogs every morning. Do ten jumping jacks, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Fire Spin. Drink 5, then take a spicy shot.
Burnt out. Drink 5, then ten more jumping jacks.
You outlast the old man. Give 5.
Natural 20! You outlast the old man. Give 10.

cards.title: Iono
cards.rules: Iono is streaming this. Say hi to chat in your best influencer voice, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Banned from chat. Finish your drink.
Chat hates you. Drink 4, then roast yourself like a hater would.
You're trending. Shout out a player by name; they drink 3.
Natural 20! Top donor. Give 8.

rule.name: Rain
rule.rule: Lost a battle? Do a short rain dance. Refuse: drink 1.

cards.title: Ponyta
cards.rules: Wild Ponyta. A horse on fire. Gallop around your chair once.

cards.title: Sableye
cards.rules: Wild Sableye eyes your teeth like they're gems. Grin wide.

strike.disadvantage: It takes a sip of your drink. Drink 5.

cards.title: Croagunk
cards.rules: Wild Croagunk pokes your kidney and laughs. Poke your right neighbor, then roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Poison Jab. Drink 3 and say "ow" like a toad.
You poke back harder. Your right neighbor drinks 3 and groans.

dice.doubles: A pair! Croagunk laughs at the player you poked. They drink {total}.

cards.title: Sandile
cards.rules: Wild Sandile is wearing sunglasses and doesn't care about you.

strike.even: Awkward. Drink 2 to break the silence.

cards.title: Hawlucha
cards.rules: Wild Hawlucha leaps off a tree and elbow-drops the table. Slam it, then roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Flying Press. Drink 4.
Body Slam. Drink 2 while your left neighbor counts to three.
You kick out at two. Give 2.
You pin it for the three count. Give 3.
Tag team: pick a partner; you both give 2.
Off the top rope! Stand on your chair and give 4.

cards.title: Mudbray
cards.rules: Wild Mudbray is a donkey covered in mud and it wants to share.

strike.advantage: You win the mud wrestle. Give 3.

cards.title: Biker Gang
cards.rules: The Biker Gang revs at you on Cycling Road. Make the engine noise, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The whole gang runs you over. Make the engine noise, then finish your drink.
Run over. Drink {total}.
They wipe out. Give 3 to whoever looks most like they own a motorcycle.
Natural 20! They wipe out. Give 6 to whoever looks most like they own a motorcycle.

cards.title: Psychic Tyron
cards.rules: Think of a number from 1 to 5. Your left neighbor guesses it. Right: drink 3.

cards.title: Snorlax Blocks the Way
cards.rules: A Snorlax is asleep across the road. Play the Poké Flute (hum loudly) and roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: It rolls onto you. Drink 3.
It rolls onto you and your left neighbor. You both drink 2.
It snores and doesn't move. Drink 2 and hum louder.
It wakes up and wanders off. Give 2.
It wakes up hungry. Whoever has the most food nearby drinks 2.
It wakes up and rolls away. Give 3.

cards.title: Lapras
cards.rules: A man in Silph Co. gives you a Lapras for free. Don't ask why. Take it?

cards.title: Evolution Stone
cards.rules: A shop sells evolution stones for the price of your dignity. Your starter wants one.

cards.title: Celadon Center
cards.rules: Celadon's Pokémon Center has a Game Corner next door. Everyone resists. Toast to resisting.

cards.title: Celadon Department
cards.rules: Five floors of shopping and a rooftop vending machine. The clerk is drunk.

cards.title: Game Corner
cards.rules: Walk past the Game Corner, or go in and see who's still at the tables.

cards.title: Slot Machine
cards.rules: One more pull. You can feel it. Pull or walk?

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The house wins. Drink 8.
The house wins. Drink 4.
Jackpot! Everyone cheers; the quietest drinks 4.
Natural 20! Jackpot! Everyone cheers; the quietest drinks 8.

cards.title: Wingull
cards.rules: Wild Wingull snatches a chip out of your hand.

cards.title: Ralts
cards.rules: Wild Ralts senses your feelings and looks worried. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It cries with you. Drink 6 for your feelings.
It cries with you. Drink 3 for your feelings.
It feels better. Compliment the player on your left: they give 3.
Natural 20! It feels better. Compliment the player on your left: they give 6.

cards.title: Phanpy
cards.rules: Wild Phanpy sprays you with its trunk. Trumpet back, then roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Rollout, right into your chair. Drink 3 and scoot back.
You out-trumpet it. Everyone trumpets; the weakest trumpet drinks 3.

cards.title: Gotcha!
cards.rules: On three, everyone points at a player. Any two who point at each other both drink 2.

cards.title: Safari Toss
cards.rules: The player on your right flicks a coaster across the table. Flat: you give 2. Else they drink 2.

cards.title: Poké Flute
cards.rules: The drawer hums a lullaby. The first player to yawn or sigh drinks 2.

cards.title: Lost Item
cards.rules: Everyone checks their pockets. The player with the fewest things in them drinks 2.

cards.title: Rival's Rant
cards.rules: Insult the player on your left in your best rival voice. If the table finds it weak, drink 2.

cards.title: Sun Stone
cards.rules: A Sun Stone glows in a flower patch. Your starter leans toward it.

elite.title: Rocket Executive
elite.rules: Behind the poster: a Rocket executive with a Raticate the size of a dog. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Hyper Fang to the shin. Drink 8 and hop.
Hyper Fang to the shin. Drink 4 and hop.
He drops the Silph Scope. Point it at a player: they drink 4 and confess a guilty pleasure.
Natural 20! He drops the Silph Scope. Point it at a player: they drink 8 and confess a guilty pleasure.

elite.title: Gambler Lou
elite.rules: Gambler Lou bets his whole stack. Push your drink to the middle, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He takes the pot. Drink 8.
He takes the pot. Drink 4.
You clean him out. Pick a player to pay your winnings: they drink 4 and call you boss.
Natural 20! He hands over his lucky coin too. Give 8.

rule.name: Nightfall
rule.rule: Whisper until the gym falls. Too loud: drink 1.

cards.title: Erika
cards.rules: Erika's Sleep Powder. Shut your eyes and roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Asleep. Drink 6 with your eyes shut.
Asleep. Drink 5 with your eyes shut.
Asleep. Drink 4 with your eyes shut.
Asleep. Drink 3 with your eyes shut.
You shake it off. Give 4.

cards.title: Morty
cards.rules: Morty's Gastly stares. Out-stare the player opposite you. Blink first: drink 4.

cards.title: Flannery
cards.rules: Flannery is new and nervous and set the gym on fire. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Burned. Take a high-proof or spicy shot.
You douse her. Give a shot.

cards.title: Crasher Wake
cards.rules: Crasher Wake makes a splash. Blow bubbles in your drink for 5 seconds, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Swallowed by the wave. Finish your drink.
Hydro Pump. Drink 5, then blow more bubbles.
You ride his wave. Give 5.
Natural 20! You wipe him out. Give a shot.

cards.title: Elesa
cards.rules: Elesa wants a runway walk. Strut to the door and back. Table scores you under 7/10: drink 5.

cards.title: Ramos
cards.rules: Ramos is 90 and tougher than you. Talk like a grumpy grandpa, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Rototilled. Finish your drink.
Leech Seed. Drink 5, and your right neighbor steals a sip of yours.
You prune the old man. Give 5 in his grumpy voice.
Natural 20! You prune the old man. Give 10 in his grumpy voice.

cards.title: Kiawe
cards.rules: Kiawe's fire dance. Shirt off or hips going, the table picks. Then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Third-degree burns. Drink 5, then take a spicy shot.
Burned. Drink 5 and keep dancing.
Totem Marowak falls. Give 5.
Natural 20! Inferno Overdrive. Give a shot.

cards.title: Bea
cards.rules: Bea trains hard. Hold a plank for 30 seconds. Drop early: drink 6.

cards.title: Kofu
cards.rules: Kofu sells fish. Sell your drink to the table in 20 seconds. Nobody buys it: drink 5.

rule.name: Nightfall
rule.rule: Whisper until the gym falls. Too loud: drink 1.

cards.title: Rocket Grunt
cards.rules: A Rocket Grunt guards the basement under the Game Corner. He has a Zubat. Of course. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Zubat. Of course. Drink 3.
He gives up the Lift Key. Give 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! Jackpot on the slots upstairs. Give {total}.

cards.title: Slowpoke Tail Seller
cards.rules: A Grunt is selling Slowpoke Tails. They're still twitching.

strike.even: You buy one out of fear. Drink 2, slowly.
strike.advantage: You free the Slowpoke. Give 4, very slowly.
strike.disadvantage: He sells you two. Drink 5, slowly.

cards.title: Spinner Tiles
cards.rules: Spinner tiles! A Grunt laughs while you spin in your chair.

strike.disadvantage: Dizzy and beaten. Drink 5, then walk a straight line.

cards.title: Giovanni
cards.rules: Giovanni strokes his Persian and doesn't look up. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Persian's Slash. Drink 5.
Earthquake. Drink 4 and kiss his ring.
He looks up. Give 4.
He finally looks worried. Give 4.
Persian switches sides. Give 4 and meow.
He says you remind him of his son. Give 5.

phases.rules: He stands up. Staring contest with your left neighbor, playing Giovanni. Blink first: drink 4.

cards.title: Haunter
cards.rules: Wild Haunter licks you. It's cold and it lingers. Lick your lips.

cards.title: Scyther
cards.rules: Wild Scyther in the Safari Zone. It has knives for arms. Hold very still.

cards.title: Tauros
cards.rules: A herd of Tauros. Everyone at the table stomps. The drawer rolls d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Stampeded. Drink 8; the loudest stomper drinks with you.
Stampeded. Drink 4; the loudest stomper drinks with you.
You ride one out. Everyone yells yeehaw; the last one drinks 3.
Natural 20! You ride one out. Everyone yells yeehaw; the last one drinks 6.

cards.title: Bronzor
cards.rules: Wild Bronzor is a frying pan that floats. It hums. Hum back, then roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It hums louder. Drink 3 and hum along.
You use it as a frying pan. Everyone names a breakfast food; the first to stall drinks 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! It rings like a gong. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Mimikyu
cards.rules: Wild Mimikyu is wearing a Pikachu costume and does not want you to look under it.

strike.disadvantage: You peek. It haunts you. Drink 5.

cards.title: Toxtricity
cards.rules: Wild Toxtricity air-guitars at you. Air-guitar back for 5 seconds, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Booed off stage. Drink 6 and play one more riff.
Booed off stage. Drink 3 and play one more riff.
Encore! Pick a bandmate: they air-guitar for 5 seconds or drink 3.
Natural 20! Encore! Pick a bandmate: they air-guitar for 5 seconds or drink 6.

cards.title: Beauty Cassandra
cards.rules: Beauty Cassandra says you're not her type. Fight her about it. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You're not. Drink 6 and compliment your left neighbor.
You're not. Drink 3 and compliment your left neighbor.
She gives you her number. It's fake. Give 3.
Natural 20! She gives you her number. It's fake. Give 6.

cards.title: Black Belt Kenji
cards.rules: Black Belt Kenji wants 20 push-ups. Everyone counts. Fall short: drink 3.

cards.title: Safari Zone
cards.rules: Thirty Safari Balls and a rock. Toss a napkin at your left neighbor, then roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Everything runs. Drink 3.
You hit a Tauros with the rock. Drink 3.
Out of balls. Drink 2.
Something stays. Give 2.
A Kangaskhan, with baby. You and your left neighbor give 2 each.
A Dratini! Give 4.

cards.title: Chansey
cards.rules: A Chansey in the Safari Zone. It's carrying an egg. It runs if you breathe.

cards.title: Pokémon Tower
cards.rules: The sixth floor is haunted by a ghost Marowak. Climb or leave?

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Get out... get out... Drink 8.
Get out... get out... Drink 4.
You put it to rest. Everyone whispers "rest"; the loudest drinks 4.
Natural 20! You put it to rest. Everyone whispers "rest"; the loudest drinks 8.

cards.title: Fuchsia Center
cards.rules: Fuchsia's Center is next to a zoo with no fences. Everyone makes an animal noise and drinks 1.

cards.title: Fuchsia Mart
cards.rules: A Mart near the Safari Zone. Everything costs more because tourists.

cards.title: Cycling Road
cards.rules: Walk the long way, or bike down Cycling Road, where trouble hangs out.

cards.title: Secret House
cards.rules: You find the Safari Zone's secret house. A man gives you something for no reason.

cards.title: Tangela
cards.rules: Wild Tangela is a ball of blue spaghetti, and it's hungry.

cards.title: Engineer Bernie
cards.rules: Engineer Bernie's Magnemite stick to your phone. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Thunder Wave. Drink 6 without moving.
Thunder Wave. Drink 3 without moving.
You stick them on the player across from you. They drink 3 and can't move until your next turn.
Natural 20! You stick them on the player across from you. They drink 6 and can't move until your next turn.

cards.title: Spritzee
cards.rules: Wild Spritzee smells like a department store.

cards.title: Move Tutor
cards.rules: Teach the player on your right a gesture as their new move. They use it on someone, who drinks 1.

cards.title: Hidden Machine
cards.rules: Say which chore you'd use Cut or Strength on. The funniest answer, by vote, gives 3.

cards.title: Fan Club
cards.rules: Praise your starter for 10 seconds. If the table gets bored, drink 2; if not, give 2.

cards.title: Weather Report
cards.rules: Go around naming Pokémon that change with the weather. The first to stall drinks 2.

cards.title: Gift Exchange
cards.rules: Everyone passes their drink one seat to the left, then drinks 1 from it.

cards.title: Day Care
cards.rules: The Day Care couple trained your starter while you napped. It looks different.

elite.title: Biker Boss
elite.rules: The gang's boss has a Weezing and a prison tattoo. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Smog in the face. Drink 10; whoever sits closest to you coughs and drinks 2.
Smog in the face. Drink 5; whoever sits closest to you coughs and drinks 1.
He respects you now and buys a round. Everyone else drinks 2.
Natural 20! He respects you now and buys a round. Everyone else drinks 4.

elite.title: Dragon Tamer
elite.rules: A Dragon Tamer in a cape on a bike path. Her Dragonite is in a hurry. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Outrage. Drink 5.
Dragon Rush. Drink 4.
Thrash. Drink 3 and flail.
Tamed. Give 4.
The Dragonite gives you a lift. Give 4.
She hands you the cape. Give 5.

rule.name: Sandstorm
rule.rule: Squint until the gym falls. Caught with your eyes wide open: drink 1.

cards.title: Koga
cards.rules: Ninja test: sneak a sip of someone's drink within 30 seconds. Caught: drink 5.

cards.title: Chuck
cards.rules: Arm-wrestle the strongest player. Loser drinks 6. If they refuse, they drink 6.

cards.title: Norman
cards.rules: Your dad Norman is disappointed. Make the table laugh in 30 seconds or drink 6.

cards.title: Fantina
cards.rules: Dance for Fantina: 15 seconds, no music. Table says not magnifique: drink 5.

cards.title: Clay
cards.rules: Clay is a cowboy with a mine and no patience. Tip your hat, partner, and roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Buried in the mine. Finish your drink.
Earthquake. Yell "yeehaw", then drink 5.
You strike gold. Everyone tips their hat; the last one drinks 3.
Natural 20! You strike gold. Everyone tips their hat; the last one drinks 6.

cards.title: Clemont
cards.rules: Clemont's invention will blow. Shout "The future is now, thanks to science!" and roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Singed afro. Finish your drink.
It explodes. Drink 5 and shout the slogan again.
It works for once. Give 5.
Natural 20! Science! Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: Mallow
cards.rules: Mallow's cooking: splash three players' drinks into yours, then down it. Gag: drink 6.

cards.title: Opal
cards.rules: Opal wants a pink successor. Name 5 pink things in 10 seconds. Miss one: drink 5.

cards.title: Larry
cards.rules: Larry is a tired salaryman. Do your saddest desk-job sigh, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Performance review. Finish your drink.
Overtime. Drink 5 and sigh again.
You clock out early. Give 5.
Natural 20! Promoted. Give a shot.

rule.name: Sandstorm
rule.rule: Squint until the gym falls. Caught with your eyes wide open: drink 1.

cards.title: Gyarados
cards.rules: You fished for a Magikarp and got its angry dad. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Hyper Beam. Drink 4, then recharge: say nothing until your next turn.
It's yours. Somehow. Give 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! It's a red one. Give {total}.

cards.title: Lucario
cards.rules: Wild Lucario reads your aura. It knows what you did.

strike.disadvantage: It says it out loud. Drink 6.

cards.title: Zoroark
cards.rules: Wild Zoroark is disguised as someone here. Accuse a player, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Wrong person. You and the accused drink 6.
Wrong person. You and the accused drink 3.
Caught it. The accused drinks 3 and admits nothing.
Natural 20! Caught it. The accused drinks 6 and admits nothing.

cards.title: Goodra
cards.rules: Wild Goodra wants a hug. It is entirely slime.

cards.title: Tinkaton
cards.rules: Wild Tinkaton has a hammer bigger than your car, and it wants your car. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Gigaton Hammer. Drink 5.
Totaled. Drink 3 and name your first car.
It hammers someone else's. Whoever drove here drinks 3.
It steals a bike instead. Give 3.
It hammers itself. Give 3.
You trade it your keys. Give 4.

cards.title: Salandit
cards.rules: Wild Salandit's gas is toxic and smells like your ex.

cards.title: Gentleman Alfred
cards.rules: Gentleman Alfred challenges you to a battle with his Growlithe and his monocle. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Monocled. Drink 8 and speak posh until your next turn.
Monocled. Drink 4 and speak posh until your next turn.
He tips his hat. Give 3 in your poshest voice.
Natural 20! He tips his hat. Give 6 in your poshest voice.

cards.title: Fisherman Ned
cards.rules: Fisherman Ned (your left neighbor) tells a fish story. Top it. Ned wins the vote: drink 4.

cards.title: Silph Co. Maze
cards.rules: Silph Co. Eleven floors of teleport pads. Spin in your chair twice, then roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Lost on floor 7. Drink 3.
Teleported into a meeting. Drink 2 and say "per my last email."
Back in the lobby. Drink 2 and swap seats with someone.
Found the card key. Give 2.
Found the president. Give 3.
Found the Master Ball. Give 4.

cards.title: Dratini
cards.rules: A Dratini in the Safari Zone's deepest pond. It's worth every drink.

cards.title: Rare Candy Stash
cards.rules: You find a Rare Candy behind a vending machine. Your starter is drooling.

cards.title: Saffron Center
cards.rules: A Psychic heals you with her mind. Everyone thinks a nice thought and drinks 1.

cards.title: Saffron Mart
cards.rules: A Mart in Silph's lobby, guarded by a Rocket who also works the register.

cards.title: The Fighting Dojo
cards.rules: Walk past the Fighting Dojo, or kick the door in and fight whoever's training.

cards.title: Silph Gift
cards.rules: The Silph Co. president gives you a gift for saving the building. Give 2.

cards.title: Sudowoodo
cards.rules: A tree blocks the road and won't make eye contact. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It's Sudowoodo. Drink 6 and stand still like a tree.
It's Sudowoodo. Drink 3 and stand still like a tree.
You water it. It panics and runs. Everyone runs in place; the last to stop drinks 3.
Natural 20! You water it. It panics and runs. Everyone runs in place; the last to stop drinks 6.

cards.title: Rotom
cards.rules: A Rotom got into the phone. Don't drop it.

cards.title: Breloom
cards.rules: Wild Breloom throws a mushroom haymaker. Duck.

strike.advantage: It clocks a tree instead. Give 3.

cards.title: Gym Hype
cards.rules: Everyone chants the next Gym Leader's name, louder each time. The quietest drinks 2.

cards.title: Campfire Legend
cards.rules: Tell a one-sentence legend about a Legendary. The best, by vote, gives 3.

cards.title: Memory Lane
cards.rules: Share your most embarrassing Pokémon moment. Everyone else drinks 1 in sympathy.

cards.title: Cheer Squad
cards.rules: The table chants your starter's cry. Everyone drinks 1.

cards.title: Starter Selfie
cards.rules: Everyone makes their starter's face for a group selfie. The worst face drinks 2.

cards.title: Friendship Glow
cards.rules: Your starter hasn't left your side all journey. It starts to glow.

elite.title: The Karate King
elite.rules: The Karate King's Hitmonlee and Hitmonchan both want a piece of you. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Hitmonlee kicks. Drink 5.
Hitmonchan punches. Drink 4.
Both. Drink 3, and pick a partner who drinks 3.
You take Hitmonlee home. Give 4.
You take Hitmonchan home. Give 4.
You take both. Give 5.

elite.title: Veteran Hugo
elite.rules: Veteran Hugo fought in a war nobody mentions. He has a Salamence. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Flamethrower. Drink 10 and tell a war story.
Flamethrower. Drink 5 and tell a war story.
Hugo salutes you. Salute back and give 4.
Natural 20! Hugo salutes you. Salute back and give 8.

rule.name: Hail
rule.rule: Shiver before every roll. Forget: drink 1.

cards.title: Sabrina
cards.rules: Answer 3 yes-or-no questions from the table. Any pause or lie: drink 3.

cards.title: Jasmine
cards.rules: Hold a full drink at arm's length, 30 seconds. Lower it: finish it. Win: give 4.

cards.title: Winona
cards.rules: Drink 4 standing on a chair, flapping like a bird. Wobble off or spill: finish your drink.

cards.title: Byron
cards.rules: Byron is Roark's dad, and louder. Shout your biggest flex, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Steel beam to the face. Finish your drink.
Iron Defense. Drink 5, and the table rates your flex out of 10.
You dent the old man. Give 5.
Natural 20! You bend his steel. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: Skyla
cards.rules: Skyla is your pilot. Arms out, make engine noises, then roll d20 for turbulence.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Nosedive. Finish your drink.
Turbulence. Drink 5 while your neighbors shake your chair.
Smooth landing. The table claps like passengers; give 5.
Natural 20! Mile-high club. You and a partner give 5 each.

cards.title: Valerie
cards.rules: Valerie's orders: trade an item of clothing with your right neighbor. Refuse: both drink 6.

cards.title: Olivia
cards.rules: Olivia just got dumped again. Tell her about your worst breakup, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She dates your ex. Finish your drink.
She cries on you. Drink 6 and hug your left neighbor.
You cheer her up. Whoever had the most recent breakup drinks 4.
Natural 20! You cheer her up. Whoever had the most recent breakup drinks 8.

cards.title: Gordie
cards.rules: Gordie's mom is a gym leader too, and he won't shut up. Yell "MOM!" then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Gigantamax Coalossal. Finish your drink.
Stealth Rock. Drink 5 and yell for your mom again.
Mama's boy goes down. Give 5.
Natural 20! You call his mom. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: Ryme
cards.rules: Ryme raps. Freestyle 4 bars on your left neighbor. Table votes trash: drink 6.

rule.name: Hail
rule.rule: Shiver before every roll. Forget: drink 1.

cards.title: Angry Snorlax
cards.rules: A Snorlax woke up on the wrong side of the road.

strike.advantage: It goes back to sleep. Give 4.

cards.title: Gible's Dad
cards.rules: You poked a Gible. Its dad, a Garchomp, appeared behind it. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Dragon Rush. Drink 4.
Earthquake. Everyone drinks 2.
You apologize to the family. Give 3.
Gible bites its dad. Give 3.
Sand Veil: it can't find you. Give 3.
It adopts you. Give 4.

cards.title: Hydreigon
cards.rules: Wild Hydreigon. Three heads, all hungry, none of them friendly.

cards.title: Aegislash
cards.rules: Wild Aegislash switches between sword and shield every time you swing. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: King's Shield. Drink 4 and block your face with one hand.
You sheathe it. Everyone mimes a sword fight; the worst swordsman drinks 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! You pull the sword out. Make a rule until your next turn.

cards.title: Dragapult
cards.rules: Wild Dragapult fires its babies at you like missiles. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Direct hit. Drink 8 and duck.
Direct hit. Drink 4 and duck.
You catch a baby. Hand it to someone: they drink 3 and coo.
Natural 20! You catch a baby. Hand it to someone: they drink 6 and coo.

cards.title: Kingambit
cards.rules: Wild Kingambit demands you kneel. Kneel.

cards.title: Ninja Boy
cards.rules: A Ninja Boy jumps out of nowhere. Was he under the table? Check, then roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Shuriken. Drink 4.
Double Team. You and your left neighbor drink 2.
He vanishes in smoke. Give 3.
Substitute: he was a log. Give 3.
Caught him under the table. Give 4.
He was your left neighbor all along. They drink 4.

cards.title: Sage Li
cards.rules: Sage Li asks: what has keys but opens no locks? 5 seconds. Wrong: drink 4.

cards.title: Seafoam Currents
cards.rules: Seafoam Islands. Boulders, currents and a freezing cave. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Swept away. Drink 3.
Frozen cave. Drink 2, teeth chattering.
Boulder on your foot. Drink 2 and hop.
You Strength the boulder. Give 2.
You Surf the current. Give 3.
Articuno flies over. Everyone looks up; the last one drinks 3.

cards.title: Gift Eevee
cards.rules: A man in a mansion gives you an Eevee and doesn't explain. Take it?

cards.title: It's Evolving Again!
cards.rules: Your starter is glowing mid-battle. Everyone hums the evolution music, loud.

cards.title: Cinnabar Center
cards.rules: A Pokémon Center on a volcano. Nurse Joy is sweating. Everyone mops up and drinks 1.

cards.title: Cinnabar Mart
cards.rules: The last Mart before a burned-down mansion. Prices are scorched.

cards.title: Pokémon Mansion
cards.rules: Go around the burned mansion, or read the diary inside that mentions Mew.

cards.title: MissingNo.
cards.rules: A glitch flickers on the shore. Your bag could fill up. Or your save could die.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Save corrupted. Drink 10.
Save corrupted. Drink 5.
Infinite items. Give 5.
Natural 20! Infinite items. Give 10.

cards.title: Ruin Maniac Liz
cards.rules: Ruin Maniac Liz's Donphan rolls at you like a monster truck tire. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Rollout. Drink 8 and roll your head in a circle.
Rollout. Drink 4 and roll your head in a circle.
You step aside and it rolls into a ruin. Pick a player to dig it out: they drink 3 and name the treasure.
Natural 20! You step aside and it rolls into a ruin. Pick a player to dig it out: they drink 6 and name the treasure.

cards.title: Gardevoir
cards.rules: Wild Gardevoir would give its life for its trainer. You are not its trainer. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It reads your search history aloud. Drink 8.
It reads your search history aloud. Drink 4.
It teleports away, blushing. Pick a player to blush like it: they drink 3.
Natural 20! It teleports away, blushing. Pick a player to blush like it: they drink 6.

cards.title: Wailord
cards.rules: A Wailord surfaces and blots out the sun. Everyone looks up.

cards.title: Pep Talk
cards.rules: Give the player on your right a 10-second pep talk. Moved: they give 3. Unmoved: they drink 2.

cards.title: Rival's Dare
cards.rules: The player on your left names a Pokémon for you to describe in 10 seconds. Blank: drink 3.

cards.title: Dream Team
cards.rules: Name a team of six in 15 seconds. The player who stalls drinks 2.

cards.title: Center Choir
cards.rules: Everyone hums the healing jingle together. Anyone off-key, by vote, drinks 2.

cards.title: Trainer's Toast
cards.rules: Toast your starter. Everyone drinks 1 and names one thing they'll miss about the road.

cards.title: Tera Raid Den
cards.rules: A den glows like a geode. Something huge and crystal sleeps inside.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The raid boss shrugs you off. Drink 6.
The raid boss shrugs you off. Drink 3.
The crystal shatters into an orb. Give 3.
Natural 20! The crystal shatters into an orb. Give 6.

elite.title: Scientist Blaine Jr.
elite.rules: Blaine's son made a Mewtwo in a jar. He wants to test it on you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Psystrike. Drink 10, and your left neighbor reads your mind aloud.
Psystrike. Drink 5, and your left neighbor reads your mind aloud.
The jar breaks. Run! Everyone runs in place; the slowest drinks 3.
Natural 20! The jar breaks. Run! Everyone runs in place; the slowest drinks 6.

elite.title: Burglar Sid
elite.rules: Burglar Sid is robbing the mansion and you caught him. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He robs you too. Drink 10, and your right neighbor takes a sip of your drink.
He robs you too. Drink 5, and your right neighbor takes a sip of your drink.
He leaves the loot. Give 4.
Natural 20! He leaves the loot. Give 8.

rule.name: Fog
rule.rule: Call everyone 'Trainer' instead of their name. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Blaine
cards.rules: Quiz! The table asks 3 trivia questions. Get 2 right. Each miss: drink 3.

cards.title: Pryce
cards.rules: Pryce's ice bath. Chug a full glass of ice water without stopping. Stop for air: drink 5.

cards.title: Tate & Liza
cards.rules: Creepy twins. Pick a partner and speak in unison while you roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: They outmatch you. You both drink 5.
You hold them off. You both give 2.

dice.doubles: A pair! Perfect sync. You both give 8.

cards.title: Candice
cards.rules: Candice says focus! Hold a wall sit for 30 seconds while the table heckles. Drop: drink 6.

cards.title: Brycen
cards.rules: Brycen was a movie star. Act out a movie. Table can't name it in 20 seconds: drink 6.

cards.title: Olympia
cards.rules: Olympia has seen your future and it's bleak. Stare into her eyes, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Doomed. Finish your drink.
As foretold. Drink 6 without breaking eye contact.
You change fate. Tell a player's future; they drink 4.
Natural 20! You foresaw her loss. Everyone else drinks 4.

cards.title: Nanu
cards.rules: Nanu's a lazy cop. Get someone to confess a crime in 30 seconds or drink 6.

cards.title: Piers
cards.rules: Piers is a punk. Scream a verse of any song like you mean it. Not punk enough: drink 6.

cards.title: Tulip
cards.rules: Tulip does your makeup. Your left neighbor mimes it, narrating every stroke. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Clown face. Finish your drink.
Hideous. Drink 6.
Gorgeous. You and your makeup artist give 3 each.
Natural 20! Supermodel. Everyone else drinks 4.

rule.name: Fog
rule.rule: Call everyone 'Trainer' instead of their name. Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Tyranitar
cards.rules: Wild Tyranitar kicks up a sandstorm. Everyone covers their drink. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Stone Edge. Drink 10; anyone whose drink wasn't covered drinks 4.
Stone Edge. Drink 5; anyone whose drink wasn't covered drinks 2.
You weather the storm. Everyone shakes sand from their hair; the last to finish drinks 4.
Natural 20! You weather the storm. Everyone shakes sand from their hair; the last to finish drinks 8.

cards.title: Metagross
cards.rules: Wild Metagross is four brains in a steel X. It already knows your roll. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It knew. Drink 5 and say "I knew it" like a robot.
It miscounted. Think of a number from 1 to 10; your left neighbor guesses it, and drinks 4 if wrong.

dice.doubles: A pair! It did not see that coming. Give {total}.

cards.title: Volcarona
cards.rules: Wild Volcarona is a moth made of sun. Do a Quiver Dance.

strike.advantage: Your dance wins its heart. Give 4.

cards.title: Kommo-o
cards.rules: Wild Kommo-o rattles its scales like a metal concert. Headbang, then roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Clangorous Soul. Drink 5.
Mosh pit. You and both neighbors drink 2.
You crowd-surf away. Give 4.
Encore. Give 4.
You steal its guitar. Give 4.
It throws you a pick. Give 5.

cards.title: Baxcalibur
cards.rules: Wild Baxcalibur has a sword for a spine and it is very cold.

cards.title: Gengar
cards.rules: Wild Gengar is behind you. No, the other side. Turn around and roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Hypnosis. Drink 4 with your eyes shut.
Curse. You and whoever you turned toward drink 3.
It grins and fades. Give 4.
Shadow Ball misses. Give 4.
It haunts your left neighbor now. They drink 4.
It laughs so hard it vanishes. Give 5.

cards.title: Cooltrainer Duo
cards.rules: Two Cooltrainers, matching jackets, matching Dragonites. Pick a partner, then roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Double Outrage. You and your partner drink 4.
Their jackets are ruined. You and your partner give 2 each.

dice.doubles: A pair! Their Dragonites collide. You and your partner give 4 each.

cards.title: PokéManiac Ed
cards.rules: PokéManiac Ed dares you to name 10 Pokémon in 15 seconds. Miss: drink 4.

cards.title: The Waterfall
cards.rules: The only way up is Waterfall. Mime climbing one, then roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: You fall. Drink 4.
You fall onto a Magikarp. Drink 3.
Halfway, then down. Drink 2.
Wet, but you hang on. Drink 1.
You make it up. Give 2.
You are the waterfall. Start one to your left; you may stop first.

cards.title: Sleeping Snorlax
cards.rules: A Snorlax asleep on the road. It's huge. It's yours if you can carry it.

cards.title: The Truck
cards.rules: There's a truck by the S.S. Anne. Everyone knows Mew is under it. Strength it?

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Nothing there. You pulled a muscle. Drink 10.
Nothing there. You pulled a muscle. Drink 5.
Mew. Kind of. Everyone points at it; the last to point drinks 5.
Natural 20! Mew. Kind of. Everyone points at it; the last to point drinks 10.

cards.title: Last Center
cards.rules: The last Pokémon Center before the League. Nurse Joy means it this time. Everyone toasts her.

cards.title: Last Mart
cards.rules: The last Mart before the League. Everything is Full Restores and despair.

cards.title: The Badge Gate
cards.rules: The guard checks your badges. Slip through, or show off to whoever's waiting.

cards.title: Hidden Alcove
cards.rules: Something shiny in a hidden alcove. Pocket it and give 2.

cards.title: Rhyperior
cards.rules: Wild Rhyperior fires rocks out of its hands. Duck, then roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Rock Wrecker, square on. Drink 4 and hold a rock pose.
You catch one and keep it. Throw it back at someone: they drink 4.

cards.title: Electivire
cards.rules: Wild Electivire plugs its tails into the wall. The lights dim.

cards.title: Togekiss
cards.rules: Wild Togekiss blesses the table, then wants a battle.

cards.title: Final Stretch
cards.rules: Everyone does 5 jumping jacks to get ready. The last to finish drinks 2.

cards.title: Champion Rumor
cards.rules: Make up a rumor about the Champion in one sentence. The best, by vote, gives 3.

cards.title: Trainer Card
cards.rules: Each player says their trainer name aloud. The most ridiculous, by vote, gives 3.

cards.title: Victory Pose
cards.rules: Everyone strikes a victory pose. The weakest pose drinks 2.

cards.title: Badge Check
cards.rules: The player on your left asks you to name 3 gym leaders in 10 seconds. Miss: drink 3.

elite.title: Ace Trainer Rex
elite.rules: Rex says he'd be Champion if he'd tried. He has a Garchomp. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He tried. Drink 10 and say "you could be Champion, Rex."
He tried. Drink 5 and say "you could be Champion, Rex."
Rex goes home to his mom. Give 5.
Natural 20! Rex goes home to his mom. Give 10.

elite.title: Elite Four Reject
elite.rules: An Elite Four member who got fired. Still bitter. Still good. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Still good. Drink 5.
Still fired. Give 5.

dice.doubles: A pair! You get his old job. Make a rule until your next turn.

rule.name: Harsh Sunlight
rule.rule: Fan yourself before every roll. Forget: drink 1.

cards.title: Giovanni
cards.rules: The mob boss of Kanto runs a gym on the side. Kiss his ring, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Team Rocket wins. Take two shots and drink 6.
Team Rocket wins. Take a shot and drink 3.
You scrape by. Give 4.
Natural 20! You beat the boss. Everyone else finishes their drink.

cards.title: Clair
cards.rules: Clair says you're too weak for dragons. Tell her she's right, then roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Dragon Breath. Drink {total}.
You tame the dragon. Give {total}.

cards.title: Wallace
cards.rules: Cross the room heel to toe, drink balanced on your head. Spill or wobble: finish it.

cards.title: Volkner
cards.rules: Volkner is so bored he blacked out the city. Bore the table with a fun fact, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Blackout. Finish your drink in the dark.
He yawns at you. Drink 6 and tell another fun fact.
You spark him up. Whoever yawned during your fact drinks 4.
Natural 20! He's finally interested. Everyone else drinks 4.

cards.title: Drayden
cards.rules: Drayden: mayor, ancient, owns a dragon. Make the table a campaign promise, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Impeached. Finish your drink.
Voted out. Drink 6 and give a concession speech.
You win the election. Appoint a cabinet: two players drink 3 each.
Natural 20! Landslide. Everyone else drinks 5.

cards.title: Wulfric
cards.rules: Wulfric loves a bear hug. Hug three players on one breath. Breathe early: drink 7.

cards.title: Hapu
cards.rules: Hapu's Mudsdale stomps. Stomp your feet like a horse, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Buried in mud. Finish your drink.
Trampled. Stomp three times, then drink 7.
You ride her horse. Pick a player: they neigh for you or drink 4.
Natural 20! Island Kahuna. Everyone else drinks 4.

cards.title: Raihan
cards.rules: Raihan takes a selfie mid-battle. Pose for his phone, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Posted and roasted. Finish your drink.
Sandstorm. Drink 6, and the table writes your caption.
You trend. Take a selfie with a player; they drink 4.
Natural 20! Most-liked post ever. Everyone else drinks 4.

cards.title: Grusha
cards.rules: Grusha shreds. Mime a snowboard run, tricks and all. Table votes lame: drink 7.

rule.name: Harsh Sunlight
rule.rule: Fan yourself before every roll. Forget: drink 1.

cards.title: Golurk
cards.rules: A Golurk guards Victory Road: a robot made of clay and grudges.

cards.title: Steelix
cards.rules: A Steelix is the floor of the cave. You've been walking on it.

strike.advantage: You climb it like a stair. Give 4.

cards.title: Machamp
cards.rules: Wild Machamp. Four arms, no shirt, very personal.

cards.title: Boulder Puzzle
cards.rules: Victory Road's boulder puzzle. You pushed one wrong and now you're stuck. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Restart the puzzle. Drink 8 and swap seats with your left neighbor.
Restart the puzzle. Drink 4 and swap seats with your left neighbor.
Solved. Give 3, smugly.
Natural 20! Solved. Give 6, smugly.

cards.title: Veteran Ada
cards.rules: Veteran Ada wants to see your badges. Name all eight from this run. Miss one: drink 4.

cards.title: Indigo Plateau
cards.rules: The Pokémon Center at the top of Victory Road. Nobody talks. Everyone drinks 1 in silence.

cards.title: Indigo Mart
cards.rules: The Indigo Plateau Mart. Last chance, highest prices.

cards.title: Two Ladders
cards.rules: Two ladders. One leads up. The other, to a trainer nobody warned you about.

elite.title: Ace Trainer Ilse
elite.rules: Ace Trainer Ilse has six Pokémon and no mercy. Roll d6 for how many you beat.

outcomes.instruction: One. Drink 6.
Two. Drink 5.
Three. Drink 4.
Four. Drink 3.
Five of six. Give 4.
All six. Give 6.

elite.title: Ace Trainer Ben
elite.rules: Ace Trainer Ben has been on Victory Road for nine years. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Nine years of practice. Drink 10, and tell the table what you'd do with nine years.
Nine years of practice. Drink 5, and tell the table what you'd do with nine years.
Ben finally goes home. Give 5.
Natural 20! Ben finally goes home. Give 10.

cards.title: Blue
cards.rules: Smell ya later! Your rival shows up again with a full team and a haircut. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He smells ya. Drink 10 and sniff your own armpit.
He smells ya. Drink 5 and sniff your own armpit.
He cries to Grandpa. Give 4 and say "smell ya later."
Natural 20! He cries to Grandpa. Give 8 and say "smell ya later."

phases.rules: His second Pokémon. Rock, paper, scissors with your left neighbor, playing Blue. Lose: drink 3.

cards.title: Silver
cards.rules: Silver stole his starter and wants to steal yours. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Stolen. Drink 5.
He steals your seat. Drink 3 and swap seats with your left neighbor.
He learns to love his Pokémon. Give 4.
He calls you a wimp, then cries. Give 4.
He hands back your starter. Give 4.
He calls his dad. It's Giovanni. Give 5.

phases.rules: He's cheating now. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: He steals your drink. Drink 4.
He steals your seat. Drink 3.
You catch him. Give 3.
You call his mom. Give 3.
He cries. Give 4.
He apologizes. Everyone else drinks 2.

cards.title: Wally
cards.rules: Wally got healthy. Wally got strong. Wally has a Gallade. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Wally is so strong now. Drink 10 and cheer for him.
Wally is so strong now. Drink 5 and cheer for him.
Wally needs his inhaler. Everyone else takes a deep breath and drinks 2.
Natural 20! Wally needs his inhaler. Everyone else takes a deep breath and drinks 4.

phases.rules: Wally needs a pep talk. Give your left neighbor one for ten seconds; they judge it. Flat: drink 3.

cards.title: Barry
cards.rules: Barry runs into you and fines you ten million. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Pay up. Drink 5.
He runs off to fine someone else. Pick who; they drink 4.

dice.doubles: A pair! You fine him. Give {total}.

phases.rules: Pay the fine in compliments: three to your left neighbor in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 3.

cards.title: Hop
cards.rules: Hop made curry for the road and wants it rated. Rate it out loud, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He took that personally. Drink 10 and rate it higher.
He took that personally. Drink 5 and rate it higher.
He takes notes for next time. Give 4, mate.
Natural 20! He takes notes for next time. Give 8, mate.

phases.rules: Hop wants a better curry. Name five curry ingredients in ten seconds. Fall short: drink 3.

cards.title: Nemona
cards.rules: Nemona skipped class to fight you. She's been stretching for an hour. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She was going easy on you. Finish your drink.
She's warmed up. Drink {total} and stretch with her.
She asks to go again. Give 4, then high-five everyone.
Natural 20! She asks to go again. Give 8, then high-five everyone.

phases.rules: One more! Ten jumping jacks while the table counts. Stop: drink 3.

cards.title: Articuno
cards.rules: Articuno freezes the table. Everyone shivers dramatically while you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Frozen. Everyone drinks 6; the first to stop shivering drinks 4 more.
Frozen. Everyone drinks 3; the first to stop shivering drinks 2 more.
A hit! Give 8.
Natural 20! A hit! Give 16.

phases.rules: It's weakened. Throw a ball: toss a coaster into an empty cup, three tries. All miss: drink 4.

cards.title: Zapdos
cards.rules: Zapdos used Thunder. Hold hands with both neighbors to ground it, then roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Struck. You and both neighbors drink {total}.
You ground it. Give {total}.

phases.rules: It's grounded and twitching. Throw a Poké Ball: roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It shocks the ball open. Drink 8.
It shocks the ball open. Drink 4.
Click. Zapdos is caught. Give 6.
Natural 20! Click. Zapdos is caught. Give 12.

cards.title: Moltres
cards.rules: Moltres is on fire and so is your throat. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Scorched. Take two high-proof shots.
Scorched. Take a high-proof shot.
A hit! Give a shot.
Natural 20! A hit! Give two shots.

phases.rules: Catch it before it burns out: name eight Fire-type Pokémon in 20 seconds. Fall short: drink 4.

cards.title: Mewtwo
cards.rules: Mewtwo reads your mind. Tell the table your worst thought, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Overpowered. Finish your drink, then a fresh one.
Overpowered. Finish your drink.
You hold on. Pick a player: they share their worst thought or drink 4.
Natural 20! Caught! Everyone else finishes their drink.

phases.rules: It's tired. Staring contest with your left neighbor, playing Mewtwo. Look away first: drink 4.

cards.title: Mew
cards.rules: Mew is invisible, pink and giggling at you. Shut your eyes, point at a player, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It giggles off. You and whoever you pointed at drink 6.
It giggles off. You and whoever you pointed at drink 3.
Got it by the tail. Give 4.
Natural 20! It was under the truck. Give 8.

phases.rules: It's giggling inside a Poké Ball. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: It pops out laughing. Drink 4.
Click. Mew is yours. Give 6.

dice.doubles: It catches you, then lets you go. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: Lugia
cards.rules: Lugia floods the table. Roll d20; miss, and everyone drinks for that many seconds.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It floods the table. Everyone drinks for 15 seconds.
Aeroblast. Everyone drinks for {total} seconds.
A hit! Everyone else drinks for 10 seconds.
Natural 20! A hit! Everyone else drinks for 20 seconds.

phases.rules: Catch it under the waves: hold your breath while the table counts to 15. Gasp early: drink 4.

cards.title: Ho-Oh
cards.rules: Ho-Oh used Sacred Fire. It burns going down and comes back twice as hot. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Sacred Fire. Drink 4, then 8 more.
Sacred Fire. Drink 3, then 6 more.
Sacred Fire. Drink 2, then 4 more.
You ride the fire. Give 2, then 4 more.
You ride the fire. Give 3, then 6 more.
You ride the fire. Give 4, then 8 more.

phases.rules: Throw a ball into the rainbow. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It flies into the sunset. Drink 8.
It flies into the sunset. Drink 4.
Caught. The ball glows. Give 6.
Natural 20! Caught. The ball glows. Give 12.

cards.title: Raikou, Entei, Suicune
cards.rules: Three dogs that bolt when you look. Point at whoever's likeliest to bolt, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! All three bite. Finish your drink.
It ran away. Again. You and your pick drink 3.
Cornered one. Give 4.
Natural 20! Cornered one. Give 8.

phases.rules: One stops to drink. Swap drinks with your left neighbor unnoticed in 30 seconds. Caught: drink 4.

cards.title: Celebi
cards.rules: Celebi travels in time. Relive your most regrettable night out for the table, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It makes you live it again. Drink 10 and tell the ending you skipped.
It makes you live it again. Drink 5 and tell the ending you skipped.
You rewrite history. Pick a player: they tell their worst night out or drink 4.
Natural 20! That night never happened. Give 8.

phases.rules: Throw the ball back in time: say the alphabet from Z back to P, no stops. Stumble: drink 4.

cards.title: Latias & Latios
cards.rules: Pick a partner and spoon them while you roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: They slip away. You both drink 1.
They slip away. You both drink 2.
They slip away. You both drink 2.
They slip away. You both drink 3.
They slip away. You both drink 3.
They slip away. You both drink 4.
They falter. You both give 6.

dice.doubles: A pair! They collide midair. You both give 10.

phases.rules: They're tangled together. One ball for both: roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: They split. You and your partner drink 2.
Two for one. Give 6.

cards.title: Deoxys
cards.rules: A space virus with a laser. Everyone covers their mouth. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Psycho Boost lands. Drink 12; anyone who uncovered their mouth drinks 4.
Psycho Boost lands. Drink 6; anyone who uncovered their mouth drinks 2.
A hit! Give 6.
Natural 20! Caught clean! Give 12.

phases.rules: It changes forme. Strike a pose and hold it while the table counts to 15. Break: drink 4.

cards.title: Groudon
cards.rules: Groudon dried up the oceans, and now your drink. Drink 2, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Precipice Blades. Drink 4, then take a spicy shot.
Drought. Drink 4, panting.
You crack its crust. Give 5.
Natural 20! You crack its crust. Give 10.

phases.rules: The ground's cracked open. Drop a ball down the crack: roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Lava. Drink 8.
Lava. Drink 4.
Click, from deep down. Give 6.
Natural 20! Click, from deep down. Give 12.

cards.title: Kyogre
cards.rules: Kyogre is flooding the world. Everyone drinks 2 to lower the sea, then you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Tidal wave. You and both neighbors drink 6.
Tidal wave. You and both neighbors drink 3.
You surf it. Give 5, arms out.
Natural 20! You drain the ocean. Everyone else drinks 4.

phases.rules: Drain the sea: chug while the table counts to five. Stop early: drink 4.

cards.title: Rayquaza
cards.rules: Rayquaza flew down to stop a fight. Name the two players likeliest to brawl. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Dragon Ascent. You and both brawlers drink 6.
Dragon Ascent. You and both brawlers drink 3.
You ride the dragon. The two brawlers hug it out or drink 4 each.
Natural 20! You ride the dragon. The two brawlers hug it out or drink 8 each.

phases.rules: Ride it down: balance a coaster on your head while the table counts to 15. Drop it: drink 4.

cards.title: The Regi Trio
cards.rules: Nobody beat the Regi puzzle without a guide. Admit you used one, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Three Explosions. Finish your drink.
Explosion. Drink 5, and admit what else you looked up a guide for.
You crack the code. Give 5.
Natural 20! You crack the code. Give 10.

phases.rules: Solve it without a guide: spell 'Registeel' backwards in ten seconds. Fail: drink 4.

cards.title: Dialga
cards.rules: Dialga controls time. Drink for 5 seconds while the table counts aloud, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Roar of Time. Drink 10, and talk in slow motion until your next turn.
Roar of Time. Drink 5, and talk in slow motion until your next turn.
Time is on your side. Pick a player: they drink for 5 seconds, counted by the table.
Natural 20! Time stops for you. Everyone else drinks 4.

phases.rules: Stop time: freeze mid-sip while the table counts to ten. Move: drink 4.

cards.title: Palkia
cards.rules: Palkia bends space. Swap seats with the player farthest from you, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Spacial Rend. Drink 10, then swap seats again.
Spacial Rend. Drink 5, then swap seats again.
You close the rift. Whoever is farthest from you now drinks 3.
Natural 20! You close the rift. Whoever is farthest from you now drinks 6.

phases.rules: Space folds around the ball. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It lands in another dimension. Drink 8.
It lands in another dimension. Drink 4.
Caught, somewhere. Give 6.
Natural 20! Caught, somewhere. Give 12.

cards.title: Giratina
cards.rules: Giratina lives in a world turned backwards. Say your name backwards, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Lost in the Distortion World. Finish your drink.
Shadow Force. Drink 5.
You drag it out. Pick a player: they say their name backwards or drink 3.
Natural 20! You drag it out. Pick a player: they say their name backwards or drink 6.

jinx.name: Backwards
jinx.rule: Everyone calls the jinxed player by their name said backwards. Slip: drink 1.

phases.rules: Throw with your off hand: toss a coaster into an empty cup, three tries. All miss: drink 4.

cards.title: Darkrai
cards.rules: Darkrai feeds on nightmares. Tell the table your weirdest sex dream, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Sleep paralysis. Finish your drink.
Bad dream. Drink 5 while the table interprets it.
You wake up. Anyone who's had that dream too drinks 3.
Natural 20! You wake up. Anyone who's had that dream too drinks 6.

phases.rules: It hides in your dream. Eyes shut, name every player in order around the table. Miss one: drink 4.

cards.title: Arceus
cards.rules: Arceus is literally God. Pray out loud for 5 seconds, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Smote. Finish your drink.
Judgment. Drink 6 and confess one sin to the table.
God blinks. Give 6.
Natural 20! You caught God. Everyone else finishes their drink.

phases.rules: God is in the ball. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: God is not in the ball. Drink 4.
Click. You own God now. Give 6.

dice.doubles: It was always yours. Everyone else drinks 3.

cards.title: Reshiram
cards.rules: Reshiram seeks truth. Tell the table the truth about your last hookup, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Blue Flare. Drink 10, and the table asks one follow-up question.
Blue Flare. Drink 5, and the table asks one follow-up question.
The truth wins. Pick a player: they tell the truth about theirs or drink 4.
Natural 20! The truth wins. Pick a player: they tell the truth about theirs or drink 8.

phases.rules: The truth catches it: the table asks you one question, and you answer it honestly. Refuse: drink 4.

cards.title: Zekrom
cards.rules: Zekrom seeks ideals. Toast your most delusional ambition, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Fusion Bolt. Finish your drink.
Bolt Strike. Drink 5 while the table rates your ambition out of 10.
Your ideals win. Everyone else toasts your ambition and drinks 2.
Natural 20! Your ideals win. Everyone else toasts your ambition and drinks 4.

phases.rules: Pitch why you deserve Zekrom, ten seconds. The table votes. No: drink 4.

cards.title: Xerneas
cards.rules: Xerneas gives life. Give the sleepiest player a pep talk until they perk up, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Geomancy. Drink 10, and the sleepy player drinks 4.
Geomancy. Drink 5, and the sleepy player drinks 2.
Full of life. You and the sleepy player give 3 each.
Natural 20! Full of life. You and the sleepy player give 6 each.

phases.rules: It's blooming. Throw a ball into the antlers: roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It bounces off a branch. Drink 8.
It bounces off a branch. Drink 4.
Caught in a burst of flowers. Give 6.
Natural 20! Caught in a burst of flowers. Give 12.

cards.title: Yveltal
cards.rules: Yveltal drains life. Name the deadest-looking player; they drink 2. Then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Drained dry. Finish your drink.
Oblivion Wing. Drink 5 and play dead for 10 seconds.
You live. The deadest-looking player drinks 3 more.
Natural 20! You live. The deadest-looking player drinks 6 more.

phases.rules: Play dead until it lands: stay still while the table counts to 15. Move: drink 4.

cards.title: Tapu Koko
cards.rules: Tapu Koko guards the island and is an asshole about it. Bow to the island, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Electric Terrain. Drink 10 and bow to the island again, deeper.
Electric Terrain. Drink 5 and bow to the island again, deeper.
You earn its respect. Everyone else bows to you; the worst bow drinks 3.
Natural 20! You earn its respect. Everyone else bows to you; the worst bow drinks 6.

phases.rules: Earn its respect: ten push-ups or ten squats, your pick, now. Quit: drink 4.

cards.title: Necrozma
cards.rules: Necrozma ate the light. Shut your eyes, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Blinded. Finish your drink.
Prismatic Laser. Drink 6 with your eyes still shut.
The light comes back. Open your eyes; the first player you see drinks 4.
Natural 20! The light comes back. Open your eyes; the first player you see drinks 8.

phases.rules: Eyes still shut, clink glasses with your left neighbor on the first try. Miss: drink 4.

cards.title: Zacian
cards.rules: Zacian is a dog with a sword in its mouth. Bark, then roll d20.
